_help: Restaurant menu offers (no code needed). Each restaurant gets its own page at /{slug}/ and a block in the home 'Restaurant offers' section. Prices in EGP, copied from the restaurant's official menu; update lastChecked (YYYY-MM-DD) whenever you re-check them. Optional: branches [{name, place, phone}] when orders are by phone only (one call button per branch), and priceSource "facebook" when the prices come from the restaurant's official Facebook post (put the post in menu). Then run: perl tools/build.pl

about.en: Melt Chocolate is a chocolate dessert café in Cairo known for cream puffs, cookies and iced coffee. It has two branches: Tivoli Plaza Mall in Nasr City and Hazard Mall in New Cairo, and you order by calling the branch.
